skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts, services, and applications of IoT.
Understand and explain the principles of RFID technology.
Understand and explain the principles of sensor technology.
Understand and explain the principles of nano technology.
Understand and explain the principles of smart technologies.
Select appropriate sensors for IoT system design requirements.
Select appropriate actuators for IoT system design requirements.
Understand and apply data processing techniques for sensor data.
Explain key issues in IoT network architecture.
Understand and apply communication protocols suitable for IoT systems.
Install and use Arduino programming environment.
Develop IoT applications based on specialized hardware boards like Arduino.
Collaborate effectively with team members to complete group assignments on time.
Apply problem-solving skills to address IoT-related issues in real-world scenarios.
Demonstrate ability to independently learn and understand relevant IoT knowledge.
Apply critical thinking skills to analyze and solve IoT-related problems.
Effectively present learned content and practical exercises related to IoT application development.
Recognize social context and ethical responsibilities in the field of Information Technology.
